abs.title: CBD · ABS country profiles
abs.summary: Country profiles contain nationally published measures, authorities, and ABS procedures. Consult the relevant authority for the specific activity.

nagoya.title: CBD · Nagoya Protocol
nagoya.summary: A framework for access, benefit sharing, traditional knowledge, and compliance with applicable domestic measures.

cites.title: CITES · How CITES works
cites.summary: International movement of listed specimens may involve permits, certificates, and specific scientific exemptions. Verify with the relevant management authorities.

dsi.title: CBD · Multilateral mechanism and Cali Fund
dsi.summary: Digital sequence information has a separate benefit-sharing mechanism. Review current guidance and agreed sharing terms; sequencing does not automatically create a payment obligation.

dive.title: AAUS · Scientific diving guidance
dive.summary: Use the diving oversight and approval process of the responsible institution. An acknowledgment here is not diving authorization.

au.title: Australia · State and territory access
au.summary: Access arrangements differ between Australian jurisdictions. Establish the responsible state, territory, or Commonwealth authority.

auCommonwealth.title: Australia · Commonwealth biological resources
auCommonwealth.summary: Commonwealth access arrangements have a defined geographic scope; some areas are directed to other authorities.

nz.title: New Zealand · Marine reserve research
nz.summary: DOC distinguishes sampling and interference from some non-interfering observation activities. Identify the reserve and activity before reviewing permissions.

nzResearch.title: New Zealand · Research and wildlife applications
nzResearch.summary: DOC provides different application routes for research, collection, wildlife, and marine reserve activities.

us.title: US · National Park research permits
us.summary: For work in a National Park, check the park research permit process and site-specific conditions. This is not guidance for every US jurisdiction.

hawaii.title: Hawaiʻi · Aquatic special activity permits
hawaii.summary: Certain scientific activities involving aquatic life, gear, or restricted areas can require a Special Activity Permit.

hawaiiLand.title: Hawaiʻi · Forestry and wildlife permits
hawaiiLand.summary: Access, collection, and protected species permissions can involve different DLNR programs and other agencies.

br.title: Brazil · SisGen
br.summary: Review the SisGen pathway for genetic heritage and associated traditional knowledge with the responsible Brazilian institution.

brCollection.title: Brazil · SISBIO research authorization
brCollection.summary: Collection and research authorization through SISBIO is a separate question from genetic heritage registration.

za.title: South Africa · BABS permitting
za.summary: Bioprospecting, export, and other research can follow different routes. Other research may still require provincial or agency collection permissions.

in.title: India · National Biodiversity Authority
in.summary: Check current NBA measures, collaboration arrangements, and the relevant state biodiversity authority. The catalog includes the 2025 ABS regulations.

fr.title: France · Access and benefit sharing
fr.summary: The general French system distinguishes non-commercial declarations, commercial authorization, and associated traditional knowledge. Verify scope and territorial exceptions.

localContexts.title: Local Contexts · Hub project identifiers
localContexts.summary: Researchers and institutions can create Hub projects and find each Project ID by opening View Project.

AU.title: Australia
AU.note: Identify the state, territory, or Commonwealth area before deciding which access pathway to review.

NZ.title: New Zealand
NZ.note: Match the activity and location to DOC research, wildlife, and marine reserve guidance. Record local access and community arrangements separately.

US.title: United States
US.note: Identify the state, land manager, and protected-area authority. The embedded examples cover National Parks and Hawaiʻi; they do not cover every US jurisdiction.

BR.title: Brazil
BR.note: Treat genetic heritage/SisGen review and SISBIO collection or research authorization as separate tasks.

ZA.title: South Africa
ZA.note: Distinguish bioprospecting and export from other research, then check provincial or agency collecting permissions.

IN.title: India
IN.note: Review the current NBA pathway, institutional collaboration, and relevant state biodiversity authority.

FR.title: France
FR.note: Review the activity, commercial intent, associated knowledge, and applicable territory. Check both access and user-compliance pathways.

observations.detail: Record organisms and places without collecting material.

mixed.label: A combination
mixed.detail: Combine new material, existing collections, and observations.

unsure.label: Still planning
unsure.detail: Save what you know and return to the open questions.

rules.title: Clarify the study activities
rules.rationale: The collection approach is still being defined.
rules.action: Confirm whether material will be collected, reused, or only observed.

rules.title: Identify the origin country
rules.rationale: Country guidance depends on the origin of material or observations.
rules.action: Add a country for each site or collection source.

rules.title: Review local access and research permissions
rules.rationale: Field activities can involve land managers, communities, and subnational authorities.
rules.action: Identify site managers and review entry, research, collection, and community-access arrangements. Record applicable references.

rules.title: Review collecting authorization
rules.rationale: The project includes collection of new biological material.
rules.action: Check collecting, wildlife, fisheries, and institutional ethics requirements for the taxa and methods at this site.

rules.title: Review the protected-area conditions
rules.rationale: A site is protected, or its status has not been confirmed.
rules.action: Identify the area and manager. Check the actual activity and permit scope; a country-level answer does not resolve site restrictions.

rules.title: Resolve the protected-area policy conflict
rules.rationale: The project excludes protected-area collection, but a planned collection site is marked protected.
rules.action: Change the site or explicitly revise the project policy before planning collection there.

rules.title: Review access and benefit sharing
rules.rationale: Genetic or biochemical research is planned or still uncertain.
rules.action: Confirm the applicable provider-country measures with the authority or partner. Review prior informed consent, mutually agreed terms, benefit-sharing terms, and any IRCC. Record why a pathway is or is not applicable.

rules.title: Check obligations in the research country
rules.rationale: Research is using genetic resources, potentially from another jurisdiction.
rules.action: Review the research institution’s due-diligence process and applicable user-country requirements alongside provider-country measures.

rules.title: Confirm provenance and permitted reuse
rules.rationale: The project uses previously collected material.
rules.action: Record the original origin, dates, collector, permissions, and reuse or transfer restrictions. A new project does not replace the original terms.

rules.title: Review material transfer and border requirements
rules.rationale: Material transfer is planned or has not been ruled out.
rules.action: Confirm origin and destination, recipient, material transfer terms, export/import and biosecurity requirements. If listed species are involved, check CITES applicability and any scientific exemptions.

rules.title: Check protected species requirements
rules.rationale: Protected-species involvement is possible or unresolved.
rules.action: Identify taxa and the relevant wildlife, fisheries, or conservation authority. Review handling and institutional ethics requirements for the actual methods.

rules.title: Arrange institutional diving review
rules.rationale: SCUBA is planned or still being considered.
rules.action: Identify the responsible diving program and reviewer. Link the reviewed diving plan and any site-specific requirements.

rules.title: Review traditional knowledge and Indigenous community interests
rules.rationale: The study may involve traditional knowledge or collection in an area with historical Indigenous interests.
rules.action: Identify relevant communities and knowledge holders, and agree on consent, uses, and sharing terms. Record a Local Contexts project reference when available.

rules.title: Review sequence-data sharing terms
rules.rationale: The study involves genetic or biochemical research.
rules.action: If sequence data will be generated or reused, review publication permissions, repository terms, and current DSI guidance. Do not infer a Cali Fund payment from sequencing alone.

rules.title: Confirm collection dates
rules.rationale: The collection dates are missing or explicitly uncertain.
rules.action: Record actual dates for existing material or the planned dates for fieldwork. Compare permissions with those dates, not only today.

rules.title: Review sensitive metadata before release
rules.rationale: The project has not chosen a members-only default.
rules.action: Review locations, permit references, and community terms before making metadata public.

rules.title: Record the site-review acknowledgment
rules.rationale: The fieldwork review process has not been acknowledged.
rules.action: Confirm the planned site-review process. This acknowledgment is separate from any permit or approval.

rules.title: Supply the RepAdapt specification
rules.rationale: RepAdapt is selected, but its exact mapping has not been defined in this prototype.
rules.action: Provide the authoritative template before implementing reading or writing. This selection is saved as a provisional profile.
